page.overview:
Who is Horace?

Horace came to Division to bring Mikaela the profits from the Arrakis haul, minus what her spice smugglers took off the top. She told him that was expected. When Keiran came in, he showed them that he had been able to scan the whole palace, include the throne room. Horace wanted to use the plans and strike against Javicco soon, while Keiran wanted to wait a bit longer. Mikaela suggested that Keiran's reluctance was him being disloyal to the cause, but he assured them that wasn't the case.

Horace met with Duri, who sold him a drone that could navigate into the throne room and then explode, killing everyone in the room. They then took the drone to show Mikaela. Then Horace programmed in the palace schematics. However, before they could implement this plan, Imperium guards, working on intel from Desmond, who had gotten it from Natalya, arrested him and Duri and brought them to the palace, where Desmond publicly executed them.
